Title: Superman/Batman Vol 1 72

URL Source: https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman_Vol_1_72

Markdown Content:
****_Superman/Batman_ #72**** is an issue of the series [_Superman/Batman_ (Volume 1)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman_Vol_1 "Superman/Batman Vol 1") with a cover date of [July, 2010](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2010,_July "Category:2010, July"). It was published on May 19, 2010.

## Synopsis for "Worship"

[Superman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Kal-El_(New_Earth) "Kal-El (New Earth)") flies through space to take care of a dangerous comet on a collision course towards Earth. He destroys the comet, but trace amounts of [Green Kryptonite](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Kryptonite "Green Kryptonite") are present and temporarily weakens Superman's powers. He crash lands on an [alien](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Alien "Alien") planet and levels a civilian construct. He executes a quick rebuild and flies back towards Earth.

Meanwhile on Earth, Lois Lane attends funeral services for a recently deceased [Daily Planet](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Daily_Planet "Daily Planet") employee. After the service, she is greeted by a driver who offers to take her back to the Planet. As she gets into the vehicle, she quickly realizes that the occupants are men who intend her harm. She tries to fight back, but they subdue her and take her elsewhere. Lois activates an emergency signal on her wedding ring.

Superman fails to pick up the signal, but it is received by another. In [Gotham City](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Gotham_City "Gotham City"), [Batman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Bruce_Wayne_(New_Earth) "Bruce Wayne (New Earth)") picks up Lois' signal. After determining that Superman is unavailable, Batman decides to investigate himself. He travels to Metropolis and trace's Lois' signal to a warehouse. Batman's actions come to the attention of [Lex Luthor](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Alexander_Luthor_(New_Earth) "Alexander Luthor (New Earth)") who uses his city-wide surveillance systems to keep an eye on him.

Later, Lois' kidnappers bring her into the middle of the woods. They are in fact a cult of Superman worshipers who, unaware that Superman and Clark Kent are one in the same, believe that Lois has defamed Superman's honor by choosing a mortal mate over the [Kryptonian](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Kryptonian "Kryptonian"). They tie her to a wooden stake and set it on fire.

## Appearing in "Worship"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [Superman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Kal-El_(New_Earth) "Kal-El (New Earth)")
*   [Batman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Bruce_Wayne_(New_Earth) "Bruce Wayne (New Earth)")

## Notes

*   This issue is reprinted in _[Superman/Batman: Worship](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman:\_Worship\_(Collected) "Superman/Batman: Worship (Collected)")_, _[Superman/Batman Vol. 6](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman\_Vol.\_6\_(Collected) "Superman/Batman Vol. 6 (Collected)")_ and _[Superman/Batman Omnibus Vol. 2](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman\_Omnibus\_Vol.\_2\_(Collected) "Superman/Batman Omnibus Vol. 2 (Collected)")_.
*   This issue includes a four-page preview of [_Green Arrow_ (Volume 4) #1](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Arrow_Vol_4_1 "Green Arrow Vol 4 1").
